fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 across 10 product types, proportional; 348 styles from 463 records in /collections/all/products.json (gift card and accessories excluded

tech_evidence.names: Seasonless Wool (house-named Italian stretch wool, sold as 'naturally temperature-regulating and odor- and wrinkle-resistant')
tech_evidence.owned: own name for a sourced Italian cloth (mill not named)

craft_evidence.makers: collab only — two AGOLDE x ARGENT jeans name AGOLDE; otherwise no
craft_evidence.mills: no — every PDP gives the fabric's country ('Seasonless Wool from Italy', 'Silk Charmeuse from China') but no mill
craft_evidence.madein: 28% (22 of 80 sampled carry 'Country of Origin': China 8, Portugal 7, USA 7); fabric origin is stated on 76 of 80
craft_evidence.heritage: vague — founder (Sali) named on the about page; no founding date or place found there
craft_evidence.reasoning: Each product page gives the fabric's origin country, and about a quarter give the garment's country, but no mill, maker or workshop is named apart from a collaboration with AGOLDE. Country-level statements only: 2.
